item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera rubs a small piece of fried papad on a sheet of white paper for a school activity. She holds the paper up to the light. Which observation would show that the papad contains fat?

options.A: The paper shows an oily patch that looks shiny and translucent when held against the light
options.B: The paper turns blue-black in the rubbed area
options.C: The rubbed area leaves a violet colour on the paper
options.D: The paper dries completely with no mark left behind
